semantics.behavior: Combinational full adder; outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization required.
semantics.latency: No clock cycles or registered latency; no specified physical propagation delay.

numeric.cout: Most significant bit of two-bit total
numeric.overflow: Exact two-bit result; no overflow, rounding, or saturation

verification.plan: Exhaust all eight binary input combinations using independently calculated integer addition and compare both result bits after settling. Repeat in reverse order to check input changes.
verification.oracle: Integer total from separate unsigned input values; compare {cout,sum} to total.
verification.tool: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite compile and simulation timeouts
verification.pass_condition: All 16 comparisons pass, simulation exits successfully with PASS marker.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z inputs is unspecified; development verification covers binary inputs only.
